text:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Compact Advisor (lightweight Optimize toolkit slice). Focus: batching/caching/quantization recommendations + eval-triggered alerts. Customer asks stacking, want a launch boundary we can commit to.
aj: +1. can we target a single customer persona and 3 primary recommendations to start? keeps complexity low.
olivia: Suggest persona = mid-market product teams using hosted API with bursty traffic. They care about p95 latency and token cost.
noah: Agree. Tech constraints: must run without infra changes for hosted customers (i.e., inference-only telemetry and config flags). Fallback path = no-recommendation if metrics are insufficient.
sam: What are the acceptance metrics for pilot? we should define quantitative pass/fail.
maria: Draft acceptance criteria below — feedback pls.
```json
{
  "pilot_customers": "3 mid-market apps",
  "recommendations_per_app": "<=3 actionable recs (batch size, cache TTL, quant profile)",
  "sli": "no regression in p99 latency >5% after enabling recs",
  "cost_savings_target": ">=10% token-cost reduction projected",
  "eval_alert_precision": ">=70% true-positive on regressions",
  "rollout_gate": "manual approve after pilot review"
}
```
aj: LGTM but make sure we can compute projected cost delta from sampled traffic. will need a simple econ model.
noah: I'll own econ model sketch. plan: sample 24h prefix distributions + simulate batching impact.
noah: Also need a tiny heuristics engine: rules for recommending quant profiles based on model family + latency headroom.
olivia: For eval-triggered alerts — tie to existing eval-bot thresholds. eval-bot: Current default: drift_alert if concordance drop > 6% over 3 eval windows. We can add per-prompt thresholds.
sam: UX: recommendations should be surfaced as prioritized list with expected impact and risk. low/noisy recs marked experimental.
maria: Rollout plan: pilot -> 3 customers -> collect qualitative feedback -> expand to beta (20 customers) -> GA. timeline = pilot in 6 weeks.
deploy-bot: Note: we need a feature flag and a canary rollout window before beta. ops will require 72h monitoring.
aj: Dependencies: telemetry hook for prefix distributions (ENG-INF), feature flag infra (ENG-PLATFORM), econ model + rec engine (ENG-ML), UI surface in Console (PRODUCT+DEVEX).
maria: Action items: @noah finish econ sketch by EOD Thurs; @aj confirm telemetry hook ETA; @olivia write pilot onboarding doc; @sam mockup UI card.
maria: I'll schedule a 30m kickoff Thurs 11am. If anything blocks earlier, ping me. :rocket:
